MOCK_Saffron Millennia Cashback

Fees & charges

  • Joining fee: ₹1,000 + GST
  • Annual fee: ₹1,500 + GST
  • Annual fee waived on annual spends of ₹1 lakh
  • Foreign currency markup: 3.5%
  • 1% fuel surcharge waiver

Rewards

5% cashback on online shopping. 5% cashback on food delivery. 1% cashback on all other spends.
